title: Settings
subtitle: Account, appearance, notifications, and more
appearanceDescription: Choose light or dark mode, or follow your device setting.
notificationsDescription: Choose which alerts reach this device. Your choices are enforced by ScoutX servers, and alerts are rate-limited.
privacyDataDescription: Manage portfolio visibility and discovery below. Review how ScoutX handles your data in our privacy policy.
aboutDescription: Football Passport for players and scouts.
deleteAccountDescription: Permanently delete your ScoutX account and profile data.
deleteAccountMessage: This permanently removes your ScoutX account, profile, and push settings. This cannot be undone.
languageDescription: Choose your preferred language. This overrides automatic device detection.
changePasswordDescription: Update your password through Firebase Authentication. ScoutX never stores your password.
changePasswordFailed: Unable to change password. Check your current password and try again.
guestAccountHint: You're browsing as a guest. Create an account or sign in to build and share your Football Passport.
